newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse probes brokers after complaint.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse probes brokers after complaint.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) said on Thursday it had started investigations into four member firms following complaints by a newspaper columnist that a broker made unauthorised use of her account.
The columnist, Ninez Cacho Olivares, said the broker used the four firms for his transactions.
"The PSE special audit team... will conduct an examination of the books and records of said brokerage houses," the exchange in a statement said.
"The investigation shall commence today with Abacus Securities Corp, while Dharmala Securities, Lippo Securities and Sapphire Securities are scheduled on May 27, 29 and 30, respectively," it said.
Abacus and Lippo denied any wrongdoing.
Dharmala said in a statement that it was cooperating with Olivares, and added it had adequate controls in place.
Sapphire officials and the broker were not immediately available for comment.
